name: death-front
prompt: Production animation sheet of the exact USER-APPROVED mean vicious giant rat in the supplied reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT a layout to copy. Lean wiry quadruped, narrow angular muzzle, small narrowed predatory dark eyes, small rounded ragged ears, sharp natural rat incisors, coarse bristling brown-gray fur, muted pink-brown paws/ears and long bare segmented tail. Four paws only. Detailed shaded textured hand-painted retro dungeon game art; muted earthy palette, crisp edges, warm neutral light. Keep rat mean and nasty, never cute, fluffy, plump or baby-faced. FRONT view facing straight toward the viewer. Both eyes visible, symmetrical front paws; tail trails behind body. FOUR full-body frames in a TWO-BY-TWO equal-cell grid on a square sheet; chronological order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. DEATH collapse and final corpse, no blood/gore. Frame 1: upright low rat reels, front legs buckling. Frame 2: falling to the side, shoulder down, hindlegs folding. Frame 3: fully down on its SIDE with extended limp paws and loose tail, head resting on invisible ground. Frame 4: final motionless SIDE-LYING DEAD CORPSE, eyes closed, paws limp, clearly flattened lower than standing height, not sleeping upright or returning to standing. IMPORTANT retain the SAME anatomical scale throughout: late fallen frames occupy much LESS HEIGHT within their equal cells and keep the SAME local ground baseline. Never enlarge collapsed frames to fill cells. Direction is preserved throughout collapse; for back view head remains pointed away, not toward viewer. All four tails fully visible. Each complete rat INCLUDING ENTIRE TAIL must fit inside its OWN cell with at least 12% transparent margin on every edge and a fully transparent gutter between cells; never overlap or touch. Keep body/paw registration stable. OPAQUE RAT ON GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND: every background pixel must have alpha 0. Absolutely NO colored brown haze, glow, vignette, gradient backdrop, floor or cast shadow. No text, labels, borders, grid lines or reference turnaround layout. Preserve source detail and complete whiskers, ears, paws and tails.
